content:
alice: FYI canary promotion for service-api is blocked. CI job `canary-promote` failed with a snapshot digest mismatch when annotating the tag.

deploy-bot: Automated: Promotion attempt FAILED for registry.redwood.io/redwood/service:canary -> digest mismatch. Blocking promotion. (job 654321)

bob.k: ugh, tag race again? likely two pushes for the same tag. are we pinning digests in the manifest or relying on tag promotion only?

carla: we do pin in the manifest for deploys, but the promote flow uses tag annotate. looks like tag moved between push and promote.

dan: can we just rollback the canary? kubectl rollout undo deployment/service-canary

evelyn: hold off on rollback. need to confirm if the canary already got traffic and if images are reproducible. auditability is the concern.

alice: Canary had ~3% traffic for ~4 minutes before deploy-bot stopped the promote. healthchecks look green but artifact mismatch breaks our prom/rollback trace.

bob.k: plan: pin the promote to a digest and re-run the build. add a pre-promote check that compares remote digest to expected.

carla: quick check snippet i can add to the promote step:
```bash
digest=$(skopeo inspect docker://registry/redwood/service:canary | jq -r .Digest)
if [ $digest != $EXPECTED ]; then
  echo 'digest mismatch'
  exit 1
fi
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Promotion held. To force a promotion: deploy-bot promote --force --digest <sha256> (requires release approver)

sam.release: we need an entry in the release notes: "Promotion paused due to CI artifact race; will resume after digest pin and rebuild." also we should schedule a small change window for a clean re-run.

dan: i prefer a rebuild from the tagged commit refs/tags/v1.4.2-canary and capture the digest in release metadata. not comfortable with force promote.

alice: kicked a rebuild on runner selfhosted-canary-3, build queued.

evelyn: please also add a short postmortem item: root cause is non-atomic tag promotion. long term fix: promote by immutable digest or use a promotion lock.

bob.k: temporary mitigation is a redis mutex around the promote job. i'll open a PR and include a short test.

carla: sgtm. once new build finishes we pin digest and re-run promote. who will approve the final promote? @sam.release

sam.release: i'll approve after i see the digest in CI metadata and release notes updated. ETA 30-45m.

deploy-bot: Build 654333 queued -> running. will post status updates here.

alice: thanks all, monitoring canary health and will update. :thumbsup:
